creatives.primary_text: 550 years of Light. One sacred word — Ek Onkar. This 550th Anniversary piece by Bay Area artist Sarabjit Singh is hand-embellished with 18k gold ink, signed & numbered. Exhibited at Triton Museum, Kala Sangam UK. Unlike generic home-decor prints, it carries history, blessing & meaning. 12x12 $75 / 24x24 $125. Perfect for your meditation corner or a housewarming gift. Only 100 exist. Tap to bring it home.
